title: Regular database backups to Google Drive
symptom: Users request a feature for regular database backups to Google Drive, as they want to avoid losing history if they lose their phone.
fix: The feature was implemented via a daily database save that occurs before the daily purge. To enable, go to Settings, Less Common Settings, Save Database Daily. The database is stored locally in the xDrip folder, and to sync to cloud, use an external sync app like FolderSync.
evidence_quote: To enable, left hamburger -> Settings, Less Common Settings, Save Database Daily.
